newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH KGHM TO START BOURSE TRADE ON JULY 10.
newsitem.headline: POLISH KGHM TO START BOURSE TRADE ON JULY 10.

text.p: Shares and Global Depositary Receipts (GDR) in Poland's KGHM copper concern will start trading on bourses in Warsaw and London respectively on July 10, the company said in a statement on Friday.
"The company will be listed on the Warsaw and London stock exchange on July 10," the statement, distributed to a news conference, said.

It said KGHM's public offer will encompasss 72 million shares out of a total of 200 million. Out of the public offer total, 20 million will be offered to domestic and 35 million to foreign investors in the so-called basic offer.

The basic offer may be increased by 10 million shares in case of large demand, and a further seven million shares may be offered to KGHM's offer global coordinators -- Barclays de Zoete Wedd and Union bank of Switzerland .

The issue price of the shares will be announced on June 28 after the end of the book-building process and the setting of the minimum price for the domestic large investor tranche and the foreign investor tranche.
KGHM is the largest silver producer and the fifth largest copper producer in the world.
